newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bendigo Bank buying Monte Paschi unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bendigo Bank buying Monte Paschi unit.

text.p: Australia's Bendigo Bank Ltd said it agreed to purchase the Australian subsidiary of the Italian bank, Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA, for about A$42.5 million.
The purchase price would be 1.3 times Monte Paschi Australia Ltd's (MPAL) net assets at settlement date, January 31, Bendigo Bank said.
"MPAL's net assets at this date are estimated to be A$32.5 million, which would mean Bendigo would pay around A$42.5 million to secure the company," it said.
The signing of a share sale agreement was subject to Reserve Bank of Australia approval, Bendigo Bank said.
"The business will be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bendigo Bank and will continue to trade independently," Bendigo's managing director Rob Hunt said.

"The purchase of this organisation is expected to provide us with a number of benefits, including a new and loyal client base, a broader distribution network, a solid asset base and an expanded range of services and skills," he said in a statement.
